newsitem.title: USA: First Enterprise issues auto loan notes.
newsitem.headline: First Enterprise issues auto loan notes.

text.p: First Enterprise Financial Group Inc said Thursday it issues $32.3 million of 6.62 percent fixed rate automobile loan notes, series 1997-B, through a wholly owned subsidiary.
The notes have an estimated average life of about 1.5 years and were priced 67 basis points over the comparable treasury rate, the company said. First Enterprise will act as servicer.
First Enterprise operates in eight states through First Enterprise Acceptance Co.
